persistenceDecisions: Address VO embedded inline on Cart row as columns prefixed with shipping_/billing_. Cascade-deleted with Cart.
LineItem and ShippingMethod stored as separate tables (entities with independent lifecycle). FK to cart with ON DELETE CASCADE.
CreditLine stored as separate table (entity with independent lifecycle). FK to cart with ON DELETE CASCADE.
LineItemAdjustment, LineItemTaxLine, ShippingMethodAdjustment, ShippingMethodTaxLine stored as separate tables (set-replace semantics need addressable rows). FK to parent with ON DELETE CASCADE.
Cart row carries integer 'version' column for optimistic concurrency control. Bumped on every command commit.
Storage engine: PGlite (in-process Postgres, no external server needed) for zero-friction local development. Drop-in replacement for hosted Postgres in production by swapping the DATABASE_URL.
authNote: Auth middleware reads role from x-role header. Pluggable: swap for JWT/session middleware before deploying.
